annotation.bound_parties_text: The bill would criminalise the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) to launch dangerous artefacts, so it would bind persons committing that conduct, including members of ultraviolent criminal organisations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: tornar crime o uso de veículos aéreos não tripulados (drones) para lançamento de artefatos perigosos, cria majorante para organização criminosa ultraviolenta
